# ADR-3003: A01: Direct object reference token for record slot 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Insecure direct object references bypass ownership checks.

## Decision

APIs SHALL NOT accept an unverified direct object reference token for record slot 3 (A01-3).

## Consequences

Identifiers are mapped server-side after authorization.
